name: Can I repair stucco myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair stucco myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor stucco cracks can sometimes be patched by a homeowner, extensive damage, moisture intrusion, or issues requiring texture matching are best handled by a professional. Professionals have the expertise, tools, and materials to properly diagnose underlying problems, ensure structural integrity, prevent future issues, and achieve a seamless, durable finish that matches your existing stucco.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a professional for extensive stucco damage, moisture issues, or when precise texture matching is needed; DIY is only for minor cracks.
